debtors.מספר רץ תיקים: skip: running case number, an identifier; not fetched (columns), searchable in the explorer
debtors.עיר בה מתגורר החייב: chart-cities, insight:city — spelling variants of the same city are merged
debtors.סטטוס תיק: kpi:discharge, insight:peak — feeds the ended-cases share that drives the selection note
debtors.תאריך פתיחת תיק: chart-yearly, chart-heat, chart-mix, chart-duration, chart-courts, chart-s42, kpi:peak_year, kpi:disc_years, insight:peak, insight:ytd, insight:duration — also sets the as_of date
debtors.סיבת ביטול צו: chart-reasons, chart-mix, chart-funnel, chart-duration, kpi:discharge, kpi:disc_years, insight:outcome, insight:duration, insight:mix
debtors.תאריך גזירת תיק: skip: administrative date the case file was archived (גזירה), often a month-start batch date; not fetched (columns)
debtors.סכום הצו: chart-amt — about 95% zero, shown for the cases where an amount was set, with the count disclosed
debtors.יתרה בבנק: chart-bank — about 80% zero, shown for positive balances with the count disclosed
debtors.תאריך הגשה של תכנית פרעון: chart-funnel — yyyymmdd, 0 = none; on-time share in the funnel note
debtors.תאריך מתוכנן להגשת דוח: chart-funnel, insight:report — planned date, compared with the filing date
debtors.תאריך מתוכנן להגשת תכנית פרעון: chart-funnel — planned date, compared with the plan filing date in the funnel note
companies.תאריך ביטול / הקפאת צו פירוק: chart-c-duration — count of cases with a cancellation/freeze date, in the duration note
companies.שם החברה: skip: company name, a lookup field; not fetched (columns), searchable in the explorer (lookup callout)
companies.מספר זיהוי של החברה: skip: company number, a lookup identifier; not fetched (columns), searchable in the explorer
claims.סוג תובע החוב: chart-d-type, chart-d-sys, chart-d-ymix, chart-d-pri, insight:claims_type, insight:claims_sys, insight:priority
claims.מזהה תיק: skip: case id linking claims to cases; not fetched (columns) to keep the 2.7M-row export small
claims.סכום שאושר כתביעת חוב רגילה: skip: equals the approved amount minus the priority part; not fetched (columns)
